# folio-assistant-core-typologies

The graph typologies folio-assistant-core owns, one folio-graph-typology/v1 node per file. There is no central registry for subgraph types; a harness declares its own in a kinds/ graph, each entry carrying its rationale.

Part of [Folio Assistant Core](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `folio-assistant-core-typologies`, holding `typologies`.

| file | what it is | used by |
|---|---|---|
| [`catalogue.json`](catalogue.json) | Catalogue |  |
| [`computation-witness.json`](computation-witness.json) | Computation witnesses |  |
| [`dsa.json`](dsa.json) | Data sharing agreements |  |
| [`glossary.json`](glossary.json) | Glossary |  |
| [`public-comments.json`](public-comments.json) | Public comments |  |
